name: Tesserae, Status Bar
description: Dashboard status strip: identity on the left, ambient device telemetry on the right. Renders as a fixed-height bar (48 px) or a resizable block; each chip switches between icon+text, icon-only, or text-only. Temperature and humidity come from the target panel's status heartbeat. Auto-contrasts against a freeform background colour so it stays legible on 1-bit, 4-colour, and Spectra 6 panels. Update chips (app version, panel firmware) surface as a badge dot or accent text, never colour alone.

cell_options.name: mode
cell_options.label: Placement mode
cell_options.help: Bar: full-width, 48 px tall. Block: resizable cell; chips wrap.

cell_options.name: chipMode
cell_options.label: Chip style
cell_options.help: Icon+text is the default. Icon-only hides labels (updates surface as a badge dot). Text-only hides icons (updates surface as accent text).

cell_options.name: leadingIcon
cell_options.label: Show leading icon
cell_options.help: The dashboard-name identifier icon (default ph-squares-four). Force-hidden in text-only mode.

cell_options.name: panelBg
cell_options.label: Background colour
cell_options.help: Text, icons, and rules auto-flip between ink (#1B1A16) and paper (#FCFBF7) based on background luminance; the update accent flips between two reds for legibility on light vs dark.

cell_options.name: show_temperature
cell_options.label: Temperature
cell_options.help: Latest temperature reported by the panel. Auto-hides when the target device does not publish temperature_c.

cell_options.name: show_humidity
cell_options.label: Humidity
cell_options.help: Latest relative humidity reported by the panel. Auto-hides when the target device does not publish humidity_pct.

cell_options.name: show_battery
cell_options.label: Battery chip
cell_options.help: Panel battery percentage (min across bound devices). Auto-hides for mains-powered panels.

cell_options.name: show_wifi
cell_options.label: Wi-Fi chip
cell_options.help: Signal strength label derived from the panel's RSSI heartbeat.

cell_options.name: show_broker
cell_options.label: Broker chip
cell_options.help: Short broker label (e.g. "HA") when MQTT is configured.

cell_options.name: check_for_updates
cell_options.label: Show app version + update indicator
cell_options.help: When on, the widget fetches api.tesserae.ink/version/latest. If the running version matches the latest, nothing renders; when an update is pending, a version chip appears with a badge dot or accent "-> .18" text. Aggregate install count only, no PII. Requires the master Online features switch (Settings -> System) to be on; when that is off, the widget makes no api.tesserae.ink call.

cell_options.name: show_firmware_updates
cell_options.label: Show firmware update indicator
cell_options.help: Appears only when at least one bound device kind has a newer firmware known to Tesserae AND the master Online features switch is on in Settings -> System. Renders as "FW" with badge / accent sub. Nothing renders when everything is up to date.
